acceptedSourceConclusions: The outer order is observe/CORS, body_parser, decode_path_segments, existing per-module normalizers and dispatch/guards.
The new middleware validates raw path segments with the existing strict percent/UTF8 decoder. It discards decoded strings, never replaces request URI and does not validate query text.
Legitimate encoded paths retain their previous dispatch behavior; the validator creates no alias, route, DTO or OpenAPI operation.
Bad path validation returns the recorded Native-style 400 error through existing ApiError. CORS and malformed body behavior remain ahead of it.
The API launcher only adds an explicit r2m profile and the new managed-environment branch. External returns before any managed require/load/build/seed/stop.
The new test separates 400 JSON errors from existing text/html404 and does not include query text in the existing not_found path message.
